headline: InfoBeans Technologies shares outcome of board meeting
summary: InfoBeans Technologies Limited has submitted the official outcome of its board meeting held on October 17, 2026, to the stock exchange. The exchange filing is part of routine corporate compliance disclosure requirements. No major financial results, dividends, or strategic events were detailed in this specific notice.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate price trigger

headline: Exchange seeks clarification from InfoBeans Technologies over volume surge
hook: Unusual trading activity at InfoBeans Techno
summary: A significant increase in trading volume was observed in InfoBeans Technologies Limited. The stock exchange sought clarification from the company to safeguard investor interests and ensure timely dissemination of relevant information. The company has since submitted its response to the exchange.
whats_next: Exchange to make company clarification public
why_it_matters: Volume spurts may precede price volatility or corporate disclosures.
